name: Zhangluo (小張羅) — Fiduciary Browser & Household Steward Agent
description: Open-source browser-native fiduciary household agent built on standard HTML5/JS, window.ai on-device privacy routing, WebMCP tool exposure, OpenViking consent-gated memory, and SHA-256 ad-free commerce digests.

trust_and_privacy_guarantees.pii_and_medical_routing: 100% on-device execution (0 bytes sent to external servers for allergies, prescriptions, or room sweeps)
trust_and_privacy_guarantees.commerce_ranking_policy: 0% paid ad boost; deterministic SHA-256 comparison_digest verification

tools.name: check_duplicate_inventory
tools.description: Cross-checks requested purchase items against the user's local 4-pillar Household Inventory (indexed via 12s camera keyframe diff >= 0.035) to prevent duplicate buying before checkout.

item_query.description: Item name or specification to check before purchasing (e.g., '65L Airtight Storage Box').

tools.name: verify_merchant_purity
tools.description: Evaluates candidate open-web goods/merchants using deterministic anti-ad-slop rules (>= 10 yr longevity, <= 2 branches, GB/T 20560 GI registry) and emits a tamper-evident SHA-256 comparison_digest.

category_or_query.description: Product or seasonal terroir query to audit.

tools.name: request_consent_memory
tools.description: Queues or updates a portable user preference inside the OpenViking consent-gated memory inbox; external agents can never mutate active profile state without user consent_id approval.
